.table-art{filter:brightness(.48) blur(3px)}.table{background:var(--table-art) center/100% 100%;border-radius:50%;inset:-6%;box-shadow:0 22px 55px #0009}.deck{width:21%}.table-shell{cursor:default}.roll-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid white;outline-offset:4px}
body:not([data-scene="Garden"]) .petal-sprite,body:not([data-scene="Garden"]) .garden-butterfly{display:none}body.motion-off .wing{animation-play-state:paused!important}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wing{animation:none!important}}
.table-art{background-image:var(--calm-art);filter:none;background-size:cover}
.app{width:100%;height:100svh;min-height:560px;padding:16px 20px 20px}
.top{width:min(900px,100%);margin:auto}.title{color:#334632;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #fff9}.cute{color:#786339;text-shadow:none}
.scene{position:static;flex:1;padding:25px 0 65px}
.table-shell{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(73svh,76vw,750px)}
.table{inset:0;background:var(--table-art) center/100% 100%;border-radius:50%}
.die-hit{inset:0;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none;max-height:none;transform:none;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible}
#diceCanvas{overflow:visible}.result-pill{top:100px;z-index:20}.roll-button{bottom:22px}
.deck.roots{top:17%}.deck.field{left:20%;top:43%}.deck.garden{left:80%;top:43%}.deck.vine{left:31%;top:77%}.deck.seasons{left:69%;top:77%}
@media(max-width:620px){.app{min-height:500px;padding:12px 8px}.table-shell{width:min(90vw,64svh)}.title{font-size:24px}.result-pill{top:104px}.roll-button{bottom:28px}}
@media(max-height:550px) and (orientation:landscape){.app{min-height:340px}.table-shell{width:72svh}.result-pill{left:18%;top:40%}.roll-button{left:82%;bottom:44%}.cute{display:none}}
